strings.t.costIntro: The cost below is built from the planning ranges held in the application's knowledge base, scaled to the size of this plot. The mid-point of each range is shown. Replace every line with a local quotation before the loan is sanctioned.
strings.t.financeIntro: The pattern of finance below assumes the promoter's margin and interest rate stated. A bank may set different terms, and any subsidy the promoter is eligible for will reduce the loan required.
strings.t.profitabilityIntro: Income is shown at the mid-point of the expected range and rises to the full level in the year stated. Operating cost is charged from the first year, including during the gestation period.
strings.t.repaymentIntro: Principal is repaid in equal instalments after the moratorium. A debt service coverage ratio above 1.5 is normally regarded as comfortable.
strings.t.marketIntro: Produce will be sold in the local mandi and to traders in the district unless a specific buyer is named below.
strings.t.exportIntro: The foreign market figures below describe the opportunity, not a commitment. A promoter reaches these markets through a registered exporter or a farmer producer organisation, rarely alone.
strings.t.schemesIntro: The schemes listed below normally apply to this activity. Eligibility, the rate of assistance and the application window are decided by the state department concerned, and must be confirmed there.
strings.t.riskIntro: Every project on this list carries risk. Those most relevant to this activity are set out below with the step proposed to manage each.
strings.t.assumptionsIntro: This report rests on the following assumptions. If any of them is wrong for this promoter, the figures must be reworked.
strings.t.disclaimerBody: This report was generated automatically from the information the promoter entered and from indicative cost and price ranges held in the application. It has not been checked by a chartered accountant, an agricultural officer or a valuer. The figures are a starting point for discussion, not a valuation, an assurance of income or a recommendation to lend or invest. Before this report is submitted, every cost must be replaced with a local quotation, every price with the current mandi rate, and the land title must be verified from the revenue record. Neither ViksitGaanw nor any party that supplied data in it accepts liability for a decision taken on the basis of this document.
strings.t.dataProvenance: Location names and codes are taken from the Local Government Directory dataset published on data.gov.in, imported into this device on {importedAt}. Cost and price ranges are as at {dataAsOf}.
strings.t.noCoordinates: No position was recorded for this plot.
strings.t.riskGeneric1: Price at the time of sale may be lower than assumed. Manage this by staggering the sale, storing where the produce allows it, and checking the AGMARKNET rate before committing to a buyer.
strings.t.riskGeneric2: Rainfall may fail or come at the wrong time. Manage this by insuring the crop under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana where the activity is covered, and by keeping the irrigation source in working order.
strings.t.riskGeneric3: Pest or disease may reduce the yield. Manage this by following the package of practices from the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra rather than shop advice, and by keeping a spray record.
strings.t.riskGestation: There will be no income from this plot for about {months} months after the work starts. Manage this by keeping a separate source of household income, or by taking an intercrop during that period.
strings.t.riskHighCapex: The capital cost is large relative to the size of the holding. Manage this by phasing the work over two seasons, and by confirming the subsidy before ordering equipment.
strings.t.assumptionArea: The whole of the stated area, {area}, is put to this project.
strings.t.assumptionPrices: Costs and prices are the mid-point of the planning range at {dataAsOf} price levels.
strings.t.assumptionSubsidy: No subsidy has been deducted from the project cost. Any subsidy sanctioned will reduce the loan required.
strings.t.assumptionLabour: Family labour is costed at the local wage rate and is included in the operating cost.
strings.t.assumptionTitle: The promoter holds clear and undisputed title to the land, or a registered lease running beyond the repayment period.
strings.t.suitabilityScore: This project scored {score} out of 100 against the recorded characteristics of this plot.
